name: BreweryDB
tagline: Beer, brewery, and ingredient database for craft beer applications
description: BreweryDB provides a comprehensive REST API covering beers, breweries, styles, ingredients, glassware, and related beer-industry data. Developers use it to build craft-beer discovery apps, menus, and product catalogs. Authentication is typically via an API key obtained after signup. Pricing and rate limits should be verified on the current official site, as the service has changed ownership and product packaging over time.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (key=YOUR_API_KEY); obtain after developer signup on brewerydb.com

use_cases: look up beer details by name or ID
